name: Can Oztas
biography: Can Oztas is a security researcher with applied R&D experience across several key sectors, including defense, finance, and telecommunications. His background encompasses AppSec, vulnerability research, and offensive security engineering. He is currently a PhD student focusing on the intersection of Artificial Intelligence and cybersecurity.
